about: The npm packages spec §27 allows, as data (contracts §1 and §2.5). Lists the direct dependencies of every package.json in the pnpm workspace, with the exact version pnpm-lock.yaml holds, the §27 category and the reason. Their transitive packages are accepted when they pass `licenses` (ADR-0012 decision 5). check-deps (M1-05) fails a direct dependency or version not listed here, and a license outside `licenses` anywhere in the lock.

pnpm.reason: the JavaScript workspace and its lockfile; pinned with its sha512 in package.json packageManager, which corepack checks

typescript.reason: the checkJs checker only: `just check-js` runs tsc --noEmit over jsconfig.json; never emits or ships, nobody writes TypeScript (ADR-0036)

vite.reason: the frontend build of apps/web (`pnpm --filter @rastai/web build`, run by `just web-embed` so rastai-server embeds the result); the same vite vitest already brings in, named here because apps/web's vite.config.js imports it directly (spec §27 dev tooling row: vite)

axe-core.reason: automated accessibility checks (WCAG 2.2 AA, frontend layout 2.9) in apps/web's browser tests, which run it on the rendered frame in Chromium and WebKit; spec §27 dev tooling row: axe-core. Never ships. Version 4.13.0: the newest release at least 14 days old (the workspace's minimumReleaseAge)

vitest.reason: JavaScript unit tests (`just test-js`); brings vite, the frontend build

prettier.reason: JavaScript, JSON, CSS and YAML formatting inside `just check` (owner decision 7)

@bufbuild/protoc-gen-es.reason: protobuf-es's generator, which buf runs for packages/proto in `just codegen` (target js+dts, ADR-0036); brings @bufbuild/protoplugin and its own typescript 5.4.5, used only to write the .d.ts files

@connectrpc/connect.reason: connect-es, the Connect protocol client @rastai/client's connection.js builds its CommandService and EventService clients with (spec §27 protobuf row; contracts 2.5); the client's tests serve the fake daemon with its in-memory router (testing/fake-daemon.js). Replacement path: a hand-written Connect client over fetch, the six messages and the stream envelope the daemon already speaks (control-plane layout 11.3)

@connectrpc/connect-web.reason: connect-es's fetch transport for the Connect protocol, imported only by packages/client/src/connection.js (contracts 2.5); it works in the browser, the Tauri webview and Node scripts. Replacement path: the same hand-written client over fetch as @connectrpc/connect

@bufbuild/protobuf.reason: the protobuf-es runtime the generated @rastai/proto code imports (spec §27 protobuf row; contracts 2.5)

react.reason: the UI framework (spec §27 Foundation row, contracts 2.5: used directly); @rastai/ui's components, and from M1-53 the app and plugin UIs, are React function components in plain JSX

react-dom.reason: React's DOM renderer (spec §27 React row, contracts 2.5); apps/web mounts the app with it, and @rastai/ui's browser tests mount components with react-dom/client

playwright.reason: drives real Chromium and WebKit for the component tests (`*.browser.test.jsx`, vitest browser mode; spec §27 dev tooling) and, from M1-54, the e2e tests; never ships. Its browser builds are installed by `tools/ci/install-dev-tools browsers`, checked against pinned SHA-256 values

@vitest/browser-playwright.reason: vitest browser mode's Playwright provider (spec §27 `@vitest/browser` row, owner approval 2026-10-11; it brings @vitest/browser); runs `*.browser.test.jsx` in Chromium and WebKit; never ships

@types/react.reason: React's type declarations for the checkJs checker only (`just check-js`): React ships none, and without them every JSX element fails tsc --noEmit with TS7026 (issue #51, forward note from the M1-04 review). Never ships, never imported by code; nobody writes TypeScript (ADR-0036). Owner approval of 2026-10-13: added to spec §27 beside the typescript checker. Replacement path: drop it together with the checker

@types/react-dom.reason: react-dom's type declarations for the checkJs checker only, like @types/react (the react-dom/client import in the browser tests). Never ships. Owner approval of 2026-10-13, with @types/react
